libutp vendored from https://github.com/bittorrent/libutp
Upstream commit: 2b364cbb0650bdab64a5de2abb4518f9f228ec44
Retrieved: 2026-07-16
License: MIT (see LICENSE)

Only the sources needed to build the library are vendored (the 6 translation
units, their headers, the Windows inet_ntop shim, LICENSE and README). The
upstream build files (Makefile, *.vcxproj, ucat sample, parse_log.py) are not
vendored — GMCA builds libutp through torrent/CMakeLists.txt instead. No source
file was modified.
